title: Correcting and redirecting agents: how I steer
summary: Drake corrects agents in a sentence or two: name what the agent did, the principle it missed, and the next action. His recurring corrections: look facts up instead of guessing, verify with your own tools, a missing piece is a task, aim for the limit, search before claiming, check understanding before handover, look at the real artifact. 'Fix it, don't file it' means every found defect ends fixed or blocked by a named external gate. I can run a checker for that.
goal: Correct an agent so it changes what it does next, and turn recurring corrections into rules and checks.
key_steps: Require every found defect to end fixed, or blocked by a named external gate
Move a recurring correction into the shared rules or a skill

example.code:
note fixfile: every defect an agent found must end FIXED, or BLOCKED by a named external gate
note exit 0 all closed, 1 unfinished work, 2 read error, 3 malformed line (fail closed)
text KW "found \nfixed \nfiled \nblocked \ndefect \n: FIXED\n: BLOCKED by a named external gate\n: UNFINISHED (found, not fixed, no external gate named)\nREFUSE malformed line \n\nREPORT OK: nothing left that the agent could fix\nREPORT NOT DONE: unfinished defects=\n"
note helpers: read all of stdin into inb, walk lines, compare a line prefix with the n-th
note entry of the newline separated table KW, and write table entries, input bytes and numbers
global inb uchar 65536
global num uchar 24
fn rdall to long
t = ulong 0
while lt t len inb bound 65536
k = read 0 inb t sub len inb t
if lt k 0
ret k
end
if eq k 0
ret long t
end
t = add t ulong k
end
ret neg long 27
end
fn eol s ulong n ulong to ulong
i = s
while lt i n bound 65536
if eq get inb i 10
ret i
end
i = add i 1
end
ret n
end
fn kstart k ulong to ulong
p = ulong 0
c = ulong 0
while lt c k bound 4096
if eq get KW p 10
c = add c 1
end
p = add p 1
end
ret p
end
fn klen k ulong to ulong
s = kstart k
i = s
while ne get KW i 10 bound 4096
i = add i 1
end
ret sub i s
end
fn pmat at ulong e ulong k ulong to bool
o = kstart k
m = klen k
if gt m sub e at
ret false
end
for j ulong m
if ne get inb add at j get KW add o j
ret false
end
end
ret true
end
fn emitk o ulong n ulong to void
d = ulong 0
while lt d n bound 4096
w = write 1 KW add o d sub n d
if le w 0
trap 9
end
d = add d ulong w
end
end
fn emiti o ulong n ulong to void
d = ulong 0
while lt d n bound 65536
w = write 1 inb add o d sub n d
if le w 0
trap 9
end
d = add d ulong w
end
end
fn emitn o ulong n ulong to void
d = ulong 0
while lt d n bound 24
w = write 1 num add o d sub n d
if le w 0
trap 9
end
d = add d ulong w
end
end
fn say k ulong to void
emitk kstart k add klen k 1
end
fn word k ulong to void
emitk kstart k klen k
end
fn emitu v ulong to void
p = ulong 24
x = v
while true bound 21
p = sub p 1
put num p uchar add rem x 10 48
x = div x 10
if eq x 0
break
end
end
emitn p sub 24 p
end
note a line is a verb and a defect number 0..99: found N, fixed N, filed N, blocked N <gate>
global st uchar 100
fn verb s ulong e ulong to ulong
for k ulong 4
if pmat s e k
ret k
end
end
ret 9
end
fn idnum s ulong e ulong to ulong
v = ulong 0
d = ulong 0
i = s
while lt i e bound 4
c = get inb i
if eq c 32
break
end
if lt c 48
ret 999
end
if gt c 57
ret 999
end
v = add mul v 10 ulong sub c 48
d = add d 1
if gt d 2
ret 999
end
i = add i 1
end
if eq d 0
ret 999
end
ret v
end
fn gated s ulong e ulong to bool
i = s
while lt i e bound 4
if eq get inb i 32
ret lt add i 1 e
end
i = add i 1
end
ret false
end
fn mark s ulong e ulong to bool
k = verb s e
if eq k 9
ret false
end
a = add s klen k
if ge a e
ret false
end
id = idnum a e
if eq id 999
ret false
end
b = uchar shl ulong 1 k
if eq k 3
if not gated a e
b = uchar 0
end
end
put st id or get st id b
ret true
end
fn show id ulong to ulong
f = get st id
word 4
emitu id
if ne and f 2 0
say 5
ret 0
end
if ne and f 8 0
say 6
ret 0
end
say 7
ret 1
end
fn main to int
r = rdall
if lt r 0
ret 2
end
n = ulong r
s = ulong 0
ln = ulong 0
while lt s n bound 65536
e = eol s n
ln = add ln 1
if not mark s e
word 8
emitu ln
say 9
ret 3
end
s = add e 1
end
bad = ulong 0
for id ulong 100
if ne and get st id 1 0
bad = add bad show id
end
end
if eq bad 0
say 10
ret 0
end
word 11
emitu bad
say 9
ret 1
end

common_mistake: Accepting 'I filed an issue for the owner' as done, or correcting by mood so the agent drifts back. Fix: ask which external gate blocks it, otherwise fix it here and show the rerun; make recurring corrections into checks.

evidence_note: The example ran on a Linux AArch64 host (no GPU) and its output is recorded byte for byte with a negative control. Rests on the recorded run of fixfile.om: a fully closed report passes, a filed-only report fails with exit 1, an unknown verb is refused with exit 3. The steering patterns come from Drake's sessions (steer cards are drafts pending his approval). NOT done: no study of how corrections change agent behavior.
